item.title: Two bollards destroyed by vehicle outside Co-op, 346 Rotherhithe Street, 18th August
item.description:
Two bollards on the south side of Rotherhithe Street, outside the Co-op at number 346, were sheared off at the base by a vehicle at approximately 22:42 on 17 August 2026. The vehicle did not stop. Loose masonry and fragments from the fixings remain in the carriageway and on the footway. The two detached bollards have been moved to the Globe Wharf reception for safe keeping and can be collected from there. The exposed base fixings at the kerb edge likely need making safe. The incident was captured on nearby CCTV. The registration could not be read from the available footage, but the recording is being preserved and the matter is being reported to the Metropolitan Police.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 346, Rotherhithe Street, Rotherhithe, Greater London

item.title: Building works causing significant dirt and dust across Shawbury Road, 17th August
item.description:
For those two boxes, I would make it clear this is not general street dirt — it is a continuing problem associated with the building works and is affecting a significant stretch of the road. Summarise the problem: Building works causing significant dirt and dust across Shawbury Road Explain what’s wrong: Ongoing building works at 31 Shawbury Road are resulting in significant amounts of building dust, dirt and debris being spread onto the public highway. As the photographs show, this is not limited to the area immediately outside the property. Dirt and dust have spread along a considerable section of the road and kerb line, leaving the street visibly covered in building residue. This has been an ongoing problem while the building works have been taking place and the condition of the street is getting progressively worse. It does not appear that adequate measures are being taken to prevent material from the works being carried onto the highway or to clean the road afterwards. Please could the Council arrange for the affected section of Shawbury Road to be thoroughly swept and cleaned, and investigate whether appropriate measures can be required at the building site to prevent the continued spread of dust, dirt and debris onto the public highway.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 31, Shawbury Road, East Dulwich, Greater London
